subject: Flex Credit Appeal for GCP Marketplace SMB Pilot
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP marketplace pilot — request for flex credit / pilot pricing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nimbus is excited about Redwood's latency and the prefix caching behavior. We're ready to run a 6-week SMB pilot with ~15 internal users but hit a blocker on marketplace pricing. Our procurement team did the math and the standard listing price puts the pilot above their quick-approval threshold.

Can Redwood offer a short-term flex credit or a one-time marketplace discount so we can run the pilot (objective: validate integration and route to an enterprise contract by Q3)? Specifically we're asking for: 
- 50% off marketplace list for first 6 weeks (capped at $12k) OR
- $10k one-time marketplace credit applied at activation

I've attached the pilot SOW and our internal pricing model for context. Procurement is expecting a decision this week. We're also open to a compensated pilot with usage-based billing off-platform (i.e., direct invoice) if that makes approvals easier on your side.

Let me know what information you need. Happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Head of Product
Nimbus Analytics

Attachments: nimbus-pilot-sow.pdf, pricing-model.xlsx

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Emma Chen <emma@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: GCP marketplace pilot — request for flex credit / pilot pricing

Aditya/Laura — looping you both in per Emma's ask. Quick summary: Nimbus (SMB analytics startup) wants to run a 6-week SMB pilot via the GCP Marketplace but needs a short-term concession to get procurement sign-off. They proposed either 50% off list (cap $12k) or a $10k activation credit. They indicated speed is important; decision expected this week.

Key context:
- Potential ARR if pilot converts: $180k/year projected (sales intel from Solutions).
- Product fit is strong for our SME packaging; they prefer Marketplace billing but will accept direct invoice if needed.
- Region: US, no sensitive data flagged.

Please advise: 1) Is a marketplace flex credit within our delegated authority? 2) If not, can we escalate to Deal Desk with recommended concession (I recommend the $10k credit to avoid weird bookkeeping for Marketplace listing pricing rules).

Emma — thanks for the detail. We'll reply with next steps once we confirm internal approvals.

— Soojin
Enterprise Sales (Marketplace)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Emma Chen <emma@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: GCP marketplace pilot — request for flex credit / pilot pricing

Thanks for the clear ask and materials, Soojin / Emma. I reviewed the SOW and the conversion assumptions with Finance and Deal Desk. Given the low execution risk and the strong probability of expansion into a committed Dedicated seat next year, we can approve a one-time marketplace credit subject to the following guardrails: 

1) $10,000 Marketplace credit applied at activation (non-refundable) — we will document as a marketing/pilot credit in the contract.
2) Pilot term limited to 6 weeks; any extension requires review.
3) Nimbus must sign a mutual action plan and a draft MSA addendum stating expected conversion timeline (we can provide a template).
4) Credit is only valid if activation occurs via the Marketplace listing (we'll instruct GCP PA on how to apply).

Next steps:
- Emma: please confirm acceptance of these conditions by EOD tomorrow.
- Soojin: I'll route a DocuSign amendment and a Deal record update (Deal ID NW-2027-0137).

Emma — attaching the DocuSign link for the pilot amendment; once signed we'll coordinate Marketplace activation with GCP PA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference
